prompt.title: Add a widget to your Home Screen?
prompt.lead: See the next activity on your Home Screen — without opening the app.
prompt.step1: Tap Connect widget here in the app.
prompt.step2: On the Home Screen: long-press the background → tap + → search for {{brand}}.

settings.title: Widgets and quick access
settings.description: Personal widget = one child. Family widget = multiple children. Choose a child here if you have more than one.
settings.childPickerLabel: Which child should the widget show?
settings.supportMissing: Widget support is missing in this version. Update the app.
settings.addChildFirst: Add a child to the family first, then you can connect the widget.
settings.loginRequired: You must be logged in to connect the widget.
settings.success: Done! Add the widget to your Home Screen (+ → {{brand}}) if you have not already.
settings.pickChild: Choose a child in the list above and try again.
settings.retryLater: Could not connect right now. Try again in a moment.
settings.networkError: Could not connect right now. Check your network and try again.

errors.offlineUnavailable: The widget is not enabled for your family yet. Contact support if it should be on.
errors.reauthRequired: Your session needs to be renewed. Log out and back in, then try reconnecting.
errors.nativeConfigureFailed: The app could not save the widget link. Close the app completely and open it again.
errors.notEnabled: The widget is not enabled or your session needs to be renewed. Log out and back in.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.lead: Set a daily reminder so you remember to check the schedule.

dataExport.title: My data
dataExport.body: Download a copy of all your data as CSV (ZIP file). Includes profile, children, schedules, rewards and activity history.
dataExport.rateLimited: You can only export once every 24 hours.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.storeBillingNote: If you have a subscription via the App Store or Google Play it is not cancelled automatically when the account is deleted. Manage or cancel the subscription in the store.
deleteAccount.summarySelf: You remove your own account and your access. The family, children, schedules and data for other adults remain. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.summaryLastAdmin: You are the last adult with administrative access. The whole family and all related data — children, schedules, activities, stars and rewards — will be deleted immediately and permanently. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.leadSelf: You only remove your own account and your access.
deleteAccount.leadFamily: You delete the whole family and all related data.
deleteAccount.storeBillingModal: A subscription via the App Store or Google Play is not cancelled automatically — manage it in the store.
deleteAccount.bulletSelfAccount: Your parent account and your access
deleteAccount.bulletSelfOthersRemain: The family, children and other adults remain

support.title: Technical info for support
support.hint: Copy app version, cache and a debug ID. No personal data or passwords are included.
support.copied: Copied — paste it into an email to support.

consent.adsDesc: Shows ads tailored to you on Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and Google.
consent.adUserDataDesc: Shares your data with ad platforms for better matching.
consent.adPersonalizationDesc: Personalises ads based on your interests and behaviour.
consent.emailDesc: Emails with tips, news and offers from {{brand}}.
